thread:
Marek: quick ask — can we smoke + perf bench Nightshade-6b on the dedicated-sprint pool today? Need p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, and memory profile for seq=512. Target window 15:00-17:00 UTC. cc @Lucy @Evan

Lucy: allocating 2xA10g for that window. I'll spin up canary lanes and reserve the pool. :ok_hand:

Evan: noted. I'll run the profiling harness and a latency sweep. Please drop the model artifact path here and confirm quant profile.

Marek: artifact is gs://redwood-models/nightshade/6b/v1/quant.pt — quant: int8-channel, tiling disabled for first pass.

Priya: small question: should KV cache be ON for these runs? Default for new models is off. If we want real-prod numbers, enable it.

Evan: agree — enable KV cache. Recommend batch_size=8 and continuous batching for throughput runs. Quick bench command I'm going to use:
```
./run_bench --model gs://redwood-models/nightshade/6b/v1/quant.pt --seq 512 --batch 8 --iters 500 --profile --kv_cache
```

benchbot: smoke run started (id=sr-3776543210). Running 50 quick traces for functional/latency sanity.

benchbot: smoke run finished — 200/200 checks PASS. Quick latency snapshot: p50=58ms, p95=132ms, p99=215ms (seq=512, batch=8). Logs: gs://redwood-logs/bench/sr-3776543210/

Evan: profiling notes from the full run: GPU mem peak ~11.6GB, host RSS ~2.1GB. KV-cache warmup shows ~18% throughput improvement after first 5 prefixes. Steady-state inference throughput ~= 620 tokens/sec per GPU (inference-only). Attached profiler flame: /tmp/nightshade-prof-3776543210.svg

Lucy: ran a burst test (10s ramps) across the reserved pool: aggregate sustained throughput ~1.2M tokens/min across 2 GPUs. Observed cold-start tail spikes up to 480ms for a few requests — looks like initial KV populate + disk load.

Priya: comparing to our baseline model (yesterday's quasar7b quick pass): baseline p50=52ms, p95=120ms, p99=200ms for same seq. So Nightshade is slightly higher on tail latency but similar median. Need to decide if we accept current quant profile.

Marek: thanks — differences are modest. Action items: (1) Evan run a tiled-quant (tiling on) pass to see if tail improves, (2) Lucy add warmup script to instance startup to prepopulate KV, (3) Priya add a p95 monitor and regression alert at 150ms. I'll draft the summary for publishing.

Lucy: warmup script pushed to infra repo: infra/scripts/warmup_kv.sh — it runs 50 prefix queries on boot. I'll add to the deployment hook.

Evan: kicked off tiled-quant run (job id tq-3776543220). Early result: tiled quant reduces p95 to ~118ms, p99 to ~190ms, throughput drops ~6% for small batches but tail improves. Pushing a small PR with kernel tweaks: https://github.com/redwood/rt-runtime/pull/4201

benchbot: tiled-quant job completed. Results aggregated: p50=60ms, p95=118ms, p99=190ms; throughput steady=580 tokens/sec/GPU. Artifacts: gs://redwood-logs/bench/tq-3776543220/

Priya: created Datadog monitor: infra.latency.nightshade6b.p95 > 150ms for 5m (notify: #eng-runtime + oncall).

Marek: great, that looks acceptable. Lucy, please add warmup to canary deploys. Evan, can you add the tiled-quant config to the model profile so Dedicated customers can opt-in?

Lucy: warmup added to canary hooks, scheduled for next deploy.

Evan: added tiled-quant to model catalog under "nightshade-6b:v1" as variant "tiled-quant". PR linked above includes the catalog entry.

benchbot: published bench report: https://redwood.internal/bench_reports/nightshade-6b/v1 (artifact id: br-3776543210).

Priya: I updated the perf playbook with the regression thresholds and the warmup recommendation.

Marek: I'll publish the summary to confluence and mark this onboard as complete for v1. Thanks everyone — nice quick turn. :white_check_mark:

Lucy: thanks — leaving notes in the canary channel too.

Evan: closing loop — will monitor next 24h for any regressions and post updates here if anything pops up.
